summary: Verified the /api/recipe-image/ai-generate contract + wiring end-to-end. Backend: 3/3 pytest cases pass — first call returns {cached:false, url:/api/recipe-image/img/<hash>.png}, immediate second identical call returns {cached:true, url:same}, GET url returns 200 image/png, and omitting `ingredients` (defaults to []) works. Cache key is stable on title+cuisine only (verified: same title with different ingredients returns cached url). Frontend: registered fresh user img_test_1790056941@example.com, navigated Discover -> mood -> meal -> dietary -> cuisine, generated 4 recipes. (1) LIST cards fired ZERO /api/recipe-image/ai-generate calls (expected 0) ✅ (2) Opening a recipe detail as NON-subscribed user fired ZERO /api/recipe-image/ai-generate calls within 8s (expected 0) ✅ (3) After Test Store purchase (paywall-subscribe → confirm-buy → 'Test valid purchase'), opening a recipe detail fired EXACTLY 1 /api/recipe-image/ai-generate call within 1s (expected 1) ✅. Detail hero renders (close-btn, save-detail, cook-mode all visible); the CDN fallback Unsplash image loads instantly before swap; detailed recipe body renders via the 'chef writing…' loader. Cook hands-free + Save recipe buttons present on detail. No React Native red screens; only benign warnings (deprecated shadow* and pointerEvents props, expo-notifications web unsupported, navigator GO_BACK — none related to this feature).
critical_code_review_comments: Cache key in gen_image.py is md5(title|cuisine); ingredients array does NOT affect the cache key — this is intentional (ingredients only tune the prompt), and it means changing ingredients while keeping title+cuisine will return the previously cached image. That is fine per current design.
RecipeCard.tsx correctly does NOT call useRecipeImage → list cards never trigger AI generation (verified in-app: 0 calls on list render).
recipe.tsx gates useRecipeImage with `isSubscribed && !providedImg` → non-premium detail correctly skips AI generation (verified: 0 calls). Premium detail fires exactly once (verified).
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral test user img_test_1790056941@example.com / Test1234 for the UI flow. Backend tests use unique TEST_-prefixed titles per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contract for POST /api/recipe-image/ai-generate is: request {title, cuisine, ingredients?[]}, response {url, cached}; cache key is title+cuisine only (ingredients ignored for keying but included in prompt). GET /api/recipe-image/img/<hash>.png serves image/png. Frontend wiring: RecipeCard never calls ai-generate (only detail does); recipe.tsx enables the query only when isSubscribed && !providedImg. Test Store purchase in web preview: /paywall → paywall-subscribe → confirm-buy → then click text=Test valid purchase in the RC modal; after that, isSubscribed flips true and next detail view fires ai-generate exactly once.
